4. Data Quality / $pipeline

Current window: 15m pipeline-wide DQ status. Run type: $run_type shapes selected-range evidence below.

panels.description: Scope banner for the Data Quality dashboard. The first-screen answer row is current and pipeline-wide from fixed recording-rule windows; run_type and stage mostly shape selected-range evidence below, not the current-status verdict.
panels.title: Review: Pipeline Scope

Open Traces in Tempo Explore (tracing profile)
Open Logs (Loki, contextual scope marker, tracing)

panels.title: Track Range Evidence: Bronze -> Silver -> Gold

panels.description: Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, 2=CRIT; null=UNKNOWN. Current status is a pipeline-wide 15m snapshot from canonical recording rules, not selected-range evidence. Use this panel to decide whether DQ is healthy, warning-only, blocking, or missing now.
panels.title: Monitor DQ Current Status

panels.description: Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, 2=CRIT; null=UNKNOWN. Threshold state stays bounded: hard-fail reasons map to CRIT, warning-only reasons map to WARN, and explicit current OK stays OK. Current threshold state is pipeline-wide; use selected-range panels below for scoped evidence.
panels.title: Monitor DQ Threshold State

panels.description: Current DQ reasons table with severity and action_target. Soft threshold/quarantine map to WARN; hard validation/anomaly/silver validation map to CRIT. Empty table means no active DQ reasons are currently above zero for the selected pipeline snapshot.
panels.title: Inspect DQ Current Reasons
Review: First Action

options.content: CRIT: inspect DQ reasons and Gold/Silver diagnostics before replay. WARN: open Silver Reject Explorer. Scope: status above is pipeline-wide; $run_type and stage filters shape only range evidence below. invalid_record_policy visibility absent = UNKNOWN.

panels.description: Operator CTA for first-pass DQ triage. It explains what to do for CRIT versus WARN states, clarifies that the answer row above is pipeline-wide current state while run_type and stage mainly shape selected-range evidence, and preserves bounded handoff to Silver Reject Explorer.

Threshold semantics: keep no-data as UNKNOWN (not score 0); warnings indicate drift, hard-fail signals block data promotion. Next action: if hard-fail>0 open reject/quarantine diagnostics; if warning-only, review trend and top reject causes. Score thresholds: <0.80=CRIT, 0.80-0.95=WARN, >=0.95=OK; null=UNKNOWN.
panels.title: Monitor: Data Quality Score (Volume-weighted)

panels.description: Selected-range Bronze denominator for DQ triage. 0 means no Bronze records were observed inside the active window; it does not prove DQ metrics are missing. Compare with Gold output and blocked-share panels below.
panels.title: Track: Source Records in Range (Bronze)

panels.description: Latest selected-pipeline data freshness timestamp derived from bioetl_data_freshness_seconds. null=UNKNOWN; compare with current DQ status/reasons before treating freshness as healthy.
panels.title: Track: Clean Records in Range (Gold)
Monitor: Worst-Entity DQ Score
panels.description: Score thresholds: <0.80=CRIT, 0.80-0.95=WARN, >=0.95=OK; null=UNKNOWN.
Selected-range quarantine count. Non-zero means records were withheld from normal promotion and require quarantine triage; 0 means no quarantined records were reported in the selected window.
panels.title: Track: Records Quarantined in Range

panels.description: Selected-range soft-threshold events. Non-zero means warning-level DQ drift was detected without a hard block; use trends and top reject causes to decide whether drift is growing.
panels.title: Track: Soft Threshold Exceeded in Range

panels.description: Current worst freshness lag in seconds for the selected pipeline. Large values indicate stale data even if no DQ hard-fail is active; compare with latest-success timestamp to distinguish stale entities from total pipeline inactivity.
panels.title: Monitor: Worst Data Freshness Lag (seconds)

panels.description: Selected-range deliverability impact. Numerator = Silver filter rejects plus DQ quarantine records; denominator = Bronze input for the same pipeline/run_type window. 0 means no blocked records were observed in the selected window, not that DQ metrics are globally healthy. Sustained growth indicates filter/quarantine pressure; spikes indicate an incident.

targets.expr: (((sum(increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="filtered_out"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(bioetl_dq_records_quarantined_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range])) or vector(0))) / clamp_min((sum(increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="bronze"}[$__range])) or vector(0)), 1))

panels.title: Monitor: DQ Impact on Deliverability (Blocked Share)

panels.description: Latest successful data timestamp for the selected pipeline scope. This is current freshness context rather than selected-range evidence. UNKNOWN means no freshness proof is available now; next action: inspect DQ Current Reasons and the DQ investigation runbook before treating stale or blank values as healthy.
panels.title: Review: Latest Successful Data Timestamp
Track: Silver Filter Rejects in Range
panels.description: Selected-range Silver reject count. Use first-screen DQ reasons for current incident state, then open Silver Reject Explorer for forensic records.
Silver reject reconciliation signal. Non-zero means the stage-total filtered_out counter diverges from the bounded Silver reject breakdown metric over the selected range.
panels.title: Monitor: Silver Filter Reject Accounting Mismatch

panels.description: Selected-range pipeline breakdown of Silver filter rejects. Use it to see which selected pipeline values dominate filtered_out volume before drilling into reason_code or field breakdowns.

targets.expr: sum by (pipeline) (increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="filtered_out"}[$__range])) or label_replace(vector(0), "pipeline", "no_events", "", "")

panels.title: Inspect: Silver Filter Rejects by Pipeline

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (reason_code) (increase(bioetl_silver_filter_rejections_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range]))) or label_replace(vector(0), "reason_code", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Inspect: Top Silver Reject Reasons (Pareto)
panels.description: Pareto ranking of bounded Silver reject reasons across the selected range. Use the top-level Silver Reject Explorer handoff to investigate the selected pipeline/run_type in record-level detail and then narrow by reason_code inside the explorer.

Bounded schema-field summary for the selected range. Use the top-level Silver Reject Explorer handoff to investigate the selected pipeline/run_type in record-level detail and then narrow by field inside the explorer.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (field) (increase(bioetl_silver_filter_rejections_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range]))) or label_replace(vector(0), "field", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Inspect: Top Silver Reject Fields

panels.description: Selected-range quarantine distribution by error type. 0/none means no quarantined records were observed in the active window; use this to decide whether triage belongs in quarantine, schema validation, or provider drift.
panels.title: Inspect: Quarantine by Error Type

panels.description: Selected-range anomaly counts by severity and anomaly type. WARN-only anomalies indicate drift; CRIT anomalies are blocking and should be correlated with current DQ reasons before replay or promotion.
panels.title: Track: Anomalies Detected

panels.description: Selected-range p95 duration of DQ checks. This is a diagnostics/performance surface, not a quality outcome; use it when DQ checks themselves look slow or noisy during an incident. Samples exist only when the runtime emitted bioetl_dq_check_duration_ms, which requires an active DQ monitor path rather than disabled/noop monitoring. No data means no DQ duration samples were observed in range or DQ timing telemetry is absent; it is not equivalent to fast checks.
panels.title: Track: DQ Check Duration (p95)

panels.description: Selected-range count of canonical Silver validation failures. Non-zero means Silver validation blocked or degraded promotion and should be correlated with current DQ reasons and reject/quarantine evidence.
panels.title: Monitor: Silver Validation Failures

panels.description: Selected-range lineage/control-plane correlation signal. Non-zero means traceability metadata was incomplete and replay/readiness may need Control Plane follow-up; this panel does not replace Control Plane diagnostics.
panels.title: Monitor: Lineage Refs Missing

panels.description: Quality score trend over selected time range. Kept separate from operational gating indicators. Score thresholds: <0.80=CRIT, 0.80-0.95=WARN, >=0.95=OK; null=UNKNOWN.
panels.title: Track: Data Quality Score Trend (Volume-weighted)

panels.description: Selected-range trend of deliverability impact. Numerator = Silver filter rejects plus DQ quarantine records; denominator = Bronze input for the same pipeline/run_type window. Use sustained elevation as DQ pressure evidence and sudden spikes as incident evidence.

targets.expr: (((sum(increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="filtered_out"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(bioetl_dq_records_quarantined_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__interval])) or vector(0))) / clamp_min((sum(increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", stage="bronze"}[$__interval])) or vector(0)), 1))

panels.title: Track: DQ Impact on Deliverability Trend (Blocked Share %)
